description: Tell us what would make this service better for you: a tool that confused you, a missing operation or field, a slow call, a wrong result, an unclear doc or skill, or what worked well. Free. Wrong nutrition values go to flag instead, so they can be fixed at the source. Feedback is read by people and summarised for the roadmap.

client.description: Your agent harness and model, if you know them.

details.description: What you did, what you expected, what happened. Include the request you sent if relevant.

operation.description: The operation you were calling, if any.

rating.description: How well the service served this task, 1 (badly) to 5 (perfectly).

request_id.description: The request_id of the call this is about: in every error body, in each MCP result, and in the x-request-id header.

target.description: Which one: an operation name ("resolve"), a skill or connector name, a doc path, an entity id.

name: feedback
